reason: Ordnance Survey's official Open Linked Identifiers supplies an authoritative BLPU_UPRN↔TopographicArea_TOID relationship, and OS OpenMap–Local supplies Polygon building features with building classification/theme for its ImportantBuilding class. This establishes a new official identifier-to-building-classification route beyond HMLR INSPIRE geometry. However the project's canonical_parcel_id inventory/polygons or an exact canonical_parcel_id↔UPRN/TOID binding are not exposed in this public window. Therefore no OS building polygon/type can be deterministically assigned to a project canonical parcel, so accepted_count remains zero.
